q: Life is all about mistakes. It is constant change and growth.
You need a plan to build a house. To build a life, it is even more important to have a plan or goal.
Be grateful for what you have now, and nothing should be taken for granted.
You don't need to be better than anyone else, you just need to be better than you used to be.
Don't learn to do, but learn in doing.
It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.
We can change our lives. We can do, have, and be exactly what we wish.
We think too much and feel too little.
Everybody needs a passion. That's what keeps life interesting.
I have lived with several Zen masters -- all of them cats.
It's not the men in your life that matters, it's the life in your men.
The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart.
When you love someone, you love the person as they are, and not as you'd like them to be.
If you can handle rejection, you'll learn to get everything you want.
The less you want, the richer you are. The more you need in order to be happy, the more miserable you'll be.
Start each day with a positive thought and a grateful heart.
It is our experiences that mold us into who we are...during times of adversity our true character will show.
You purchase pain with all that joy can give and die of nothing but a rage to live.
Without struggle, no progress and no result. Every breaking of habit produces a change in the machine.
Intuition is the ear of the soul.
Better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.
If it's not broken, tinker with it till you find out how it works.
For changes to be of any true value, they've got to be lasting and consistent.
You don't know who is important to you until you actually lose them.
The heart wants what it wants. There's no logic.
There is peace even in the storm.
Much learning does not teach understanding.
Make improvements, not excuses. Seek respect, not attention.
It still holds true that man is most uniquely human when he turns obstacles into opportunities.
One of the first signs of the beginning of understanding is the wish to die.
At every moment where language can't go, that's your mind.
Zen insists that the whole trouble is just our failure to realize that there is no problem.
Death is not sad; the sad thing is that most people don't really live at all.
Be fascinated instead of frustrated.
Nobody goes through life without a scar.
Anyone who reads a book with a sense of obligation does not understand the art of reading.
Not all readers are leaders, but all leaders are readers.
People who are unable to motivate themselves must be content with mediocrity, no matter how impressive their other talents.
Confidence is contagious. So is lack of confidence.
Courage is fear that has said its prayers and decided to go forward anyway.
A bird does not sing because it has an answer. It sings because it has a song.
Passion is energy. Feel the power that comes from focusing on what excites you.
The one who praises you is a thief. The one who criticizes you is your true friend.
The glow of one warm thought is to me worth more than money.
Education breeds confidence. Confidence breeds hope. Hope breeds peace.
The only reason to be alive is to enjoy it.
The worst part of success is trying to find someone who is happy for you.
You have the freedom to be yourself, your true self, here and now, and nothing can stand in your way.
If you've never eaten while crying you don t know what life tastes like.
The only place where success comes before work is in the dictionary.
